limitations: Impedance targets are recorded only; no geometry is computed or enforced.
Widths use the unmodified IPC-2152 generic-chart fit; no plane, board thickness or copper-thickness modifiers.
Net names are exact native names; undeclared nets remain in Default.
Planning output without board_raw does not establish board membership; consumers must bind every declared net to the saved board.

method.chart: IPC-2152 generic chart (3 oz, 0.070 in polyimide, still air, no planes)
method.copper_thickness: minimum over stackup copper layers of thickness_mm and copper_weight_oz * 0.034798 mm
method.fit_source: smps.us trace-width calculator curve fit of the IPC-2152 generic chart, restated; cited 2026-10-18
method.modifiers: none; the generic chart is the conservative unmodified case
